lines: Commits on track/b-returns: 52857f7 feat(admin): add client returns, ledger page and overview reads; 2961c86 feat(admin-ui): client hub page, returns dashboard and daily tiles; c54d259 perf(admin): compute XIRR only for the summary page and totals (review follow-up). Cut from main 47d82a6, not landed.
Contract file: packages/contracts/src/operations/admin-client-returns.ts (ADMIN_CLIENT_RETURN_OPERATIONS). Regenerate openapi + frontend operations.ts at landing.

Endpoints: GET /v1/admin/clients/{userId}/portfolio-summary (client_values.read, 404 unknown user); GET /v1/admin/client-values/summary?sort=return_desc|return_asc&userIds=<<=100 csv>&after&limit (client_values.read; unfiltered = users with ledger rows; userIds path returns a zero row for listed users without entries; totals over the listed set); GET /v1/admin/client-values/fund-updates (client_values.read); GET /v1/admin/overview/pending-invites (users.read or clients.password_links.send); GET /v1/admin/clients/{userId}/ledger?fundId&after&limit (client_position.write or client_values.read; cursor carries the entry id).
Landing trap (coordinator handles): b-receipts moves AdminLedgerEntry out of admin-money.ts into admin-client-positions.ts; admin-client-returns.ts still imports it from ./admin-money.js.

Pure modules: domain/shared/xirr.ts (bisection on ln(1+r), [-99.9999%, +99999900%], 200 iterations); domain/admin/clientReturns.ts (foldClientValues = sums + simple return; withXirr adds XIRR; summarizeClientReturns = both). portfolioLedger.ts exports returnBasisPoints; returnPercent unchanged.
Summary route sorts on foldClientValues and solves XIRR only for the limit page items and the totals (c54d259); output identical, asserted by paging one row at a time.

XIRR flows: contribution = outflow on effective date; withdrawal = inflow of paid value; reversal of either negates it on the original date; growth, maturity reinvestment and their reversals are not flows; current value = inflow on IST today; netted per date; null with no outflow, < 30 days from first flow, or no root. Simple return null when invested <= 0.

Sums vs positions reads: they agree because recording/growth/settlement need a live contribution (positionBasisQuery bool_or) and reverseLedgerEntry refuses the last live contribution unless principal and value both reach 0; integration asserts summary == positions sums for a client with a reversed pair, and that reversing the last contribution under live growth is 409 STATE_CONFLICT. A fully reversed client still lists as a 0/0 row with null returns.

Frontend: UserDetailScreen is the hub (identity card + PasswordLinkPanel, PortfolioSummarySection, ClientHubActions, ClientHubTabs ledger/maturity/emails/sign-ins). No support tab (b-support adds it). Overview DailyTiles leaves a 4th slot for open tickets. Returns dashboard /client-values/returns; copy says totals cover all N clients with a recorded investment.
Summary caches (qk.admin.clientValueSummaryRoot) are invalidated by recording, reversal (adminQueries.ts +2 lines, on reviewer request), growth (growthQueries) and settlement (maturityQueries).

Negative controls: dropping reversal flow handling failed 1 unit + 2 integration; widening RETURNS_PERMISSIONS failed the auth test; nulling page-item XIRR failed the paging test.
